component.name: Playser
component.summary: Play DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHD discs from the couch

description.p: A controller-first disc player for the TV, made for SteamOS Game Mode. Put in a disc and press play: Playser finds the main feature, shows the disc's title and art, and plays it in HDR with surround sound, sent to your receiver as-is if you like.
Blu-ray and 4K UHD discs need MakeMKV, which you buy separately; DVDs play without it.
